AFRINTEL CTI report - cyber incidents in Africa (July 2026)

This validated corpus contains 47 incidents or documented cases first published or first observed by AFRINTEL in July 2026. The month assignment follows the publication or first documented observation date; a compromise date is not inferred when it is unavailable.

Methodology

The figures are derived once from victims_FR.md, checked against victims.md, and reused in the reports, comparisons and STIX bundle. A multi-country incident counts once globally; country occurrences may therefore exceed the global total. The corpus measures documented AFRINTEL visibility, not the actual prevalence of cyberattacks.
